description: Tool4seller helps Amazon sellers inspect their authorized store, sales, profit, inventory, review, inbound shipment, advertising, and sales traffic data directly in ChatGPT. The app provides read-only business analytics so users can ask operational questions, compare performance, and review marketplace status without changing account data.
